title: Who Owns the Words We Speak?
seoTitle: Who Owns the Words We Speak? | Faraz Ansari
description: A personal essay on Hindi, Urdu, colonial history and belonging: how languages bridge communities, become tools of power, and shape freedom to be understood.
deck: On Hindi, Urdu, nationalism and the unfinished work of belonging
